notes: Complete list: 1 action (route, actions.js) and 1 boolean feedback (output_routing, feedbacks.js). Both are registered only after the first routing response from the switcher has been parsed (index.js, firstRun block), so they do not exist while the module is disconnected.

Protocol: Telnet-style TCP to the Crestron DM console (TCPHelper, config "Target Port", default 23, Regex.PORT), optional authentication (username and password config fields), optional polling interval (0..10000 ms, step 100, 0 = disabled). Routing commands: SETAVROUTE, SETAVUROUTE, SETVIDEOROUTE, SETAUDIOROUTE, SETUSBROUTE with "<input slot> <output slot>"; routes are read back with "dumpdmrouteinfo".

Dropdown ids are slot numbers (numbers, not strings). The "custom" checkbox switches to a text field that accepts a number or a variable (regex "/^(\d+|\$\(.+\))/" as written, without end anchor); the value is resolved with parseVariablesInString and getSlotOrOff, which treats a typed number as the LABEL of a list entry (for outputs the running index 1..n, for inputs the slot number) and returns the slot id of that entry, or 0 (Off) when no label matches or the value is not a number.

The feedback id_type option declares two default keys in the source (first "0", then "Video"); in a JavaScript object literal the later one wins, so the effective default is "Video" and that is what the catalog records. Its callback compares the stored route value with === against the dropdown id (number), so a variable-resolved value follows getSlotOrOff.
The route action field id_src sets useVariables: true on a dropdown (ignored by Companion for dropdowns, recorded as written).
Presets (presets.js), variables (RouteOut<slot>Video / Audio / USB) and the upgrade script (upgrade.js) are not catalogued.
Built on @companion-module/base ~1.11.2: options do not support expressions.
